MASTERCLASS | CREATOR CLIPPING BRIEF
OTHER PEOPLE'S BUSINESS
CLIPPING CAMPAIGN BRIEF
MasterClass's first-ever podcast
WHAT TO DO
We're launching the official clipping campaign for Other People's Business, MasterClass's
first-ever podcast, hosted by David Rogier, Founder and CEO of MasterClass. Your job is to turn
podcast footage into sharp, scroll-stopping short-form content that gets people hooked as
episodes premiere
THE PREMISE, FOR CONTEXT
Every industry has a version of itself that never makes the headlines. Every success has a cost that
never makes the story. Other People's Business gets into the real money, the actual decisions, the
machine behind everything people see and don't fully understand. David has spent more than a
decade inside conversations most people never hear — this show is built on the questions nobody
thinks to ask, and the ones you wish someone would.
FOCUS ON STANDOUT MOMENTS INCLUDING
— [PLACEHOLDER — specific episode moments / timestamps to be added]
— Bold, specific claims or numbers most people wouldn't guess
— Moments where David gets a guest to say something they clearly weren't planning to say
— “Wait, that's how it actually works?” reveals
— Any beat that reframes something familiar (an industry, a brand, a public figure) in a way
people haven't heard before
— Any irreverent, personal, funny or relatable moments between David and guests
Lean into a tone that's curious, sharp, and a little nosy — not gossipy, not cynical. The goal is “I need
to know more,” not “can you believe this.”
CONTENT
EP 5: Approved Video:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18WfIrK8WVHwDlX4-T2a19RaXcDd_wr1R?usp=sharing
⚠ USE OFFICIAL ASSETS ONLY
Download and post clips ONLY from the official content folder above. Content from any other source
will be rejected immediately.
TAGGING REQUIREMENT (REQUIRED)
Tag MasterClass in the caption on every post:
— TikTok: @masterclass
— Instagram: @masterclass
— YouTube Shorts: @masterclass — put the tag in the video title
— LinkedIn: @masterclass
CAPTION GUIDELINES
Captions are flexible, but must follow these rules:
✔“Other People's Business” must be clearly mentioned
✔ DJ Drama on Other People's Business, MasterClass's podcast - Required Caption
✔Caption must match the moment in the clip
✔ Episode Name: EP 5 DJ Drama - Business of HipHop
✔ Out Now
✔Keep the tone curious and sharp — never mocking or cynical
CAPTION EXAMPLES
— “I never thought about it like this.”
— “Other People's Business gets into stuff you're not supposed to know”
— “New MasterClass podcast, Other People's Business”
— “Nosy by design, and I'm here for it”
— “I completely missed this.”
— “I never knew this.”
— “Wait...really?”
— “I didn't know that's how this worked.”
— “I never would've guessed this.”
FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post must include one of the following, on its own line, as the first hashtag or element after
the caption text:
#Ad #Advertisement #Sponsored #MasterClassPartner
PLACEMENT RULES
— Must appear alone on its own separate line
— Must be the first hashtag or element after the post text
— No other hashtags allowed
— Must not be buried — must be clear and conspicuous
— Must match the caption's font, size, and color
EXAMPLE OF CORRECT PLACEMENT
David Rogier just said the quiet part out loud on the new MasterClass podcast
#Ad
⚠ NO EXCEPTIONS
Missing or incorrectly placed disclosure results in automatic rejection.
ON-SCREEN TEXT (Required)
Please consider using on-screen text as it will sharpen the hook and reinforce curiosity. “Other
People's Business” must appear in either the caption or the on-screen text (or both).
EXAMPLES
— “Nobody talks about this part.”
— “David Rogier gets guests to say things they shouldn't”
— “This is the part of the story that never makes headlines”
— “New podcast. Premieres Sept 9.”
— “MasterClass CEO just blew my mind”
— “Going to use this trick forever now”
— “This one insight is going to change the way I work from now on”
Text must be clear and legible — stylized fonts are fine as long as they're readable.
EDITING GUIDELINES
— Original podcast audio must be on the clip, however you are welcome to use royalty-free music
as well
— Trimming, cutting, zooming, captions, and on-screen text are all encouraged
— Do not add unrelated b-roll
REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔Use official assets only
✔Tag @masterclass in the caption on every post
✔Include a properly formatted FTC disclosure
✔No separate audio/music added
✔High-quality edits only — no blurry or low-effort content
✔Video must be at least 10 seconds
✔English content only
✔Post must stay live 60 days minimum — early deletion may result in a ban
NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌Footage from any source outside the official content folder
❌Negative, critical, or mocking commentary about David Rogier, guests, MasterClass, or the
podcast
❌Political commentary or real-world controversy insertion
❌Mentioning unrelated third-party brands, shows, or podcasts
❌Misleading claims about the show or its content
❌Low-quality or lazy uploads
DISCLOSURE VIOLATIONS
❌Missing disclosure
❌Disclosure placed incorrectly
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌Bait posting unrelated to the campaign
❌Duplicate/spam posting across multiple accounts
❌Story-only posting (does not count toward views)
❌Paid boosting or promotion of any kind
POST VIOLATIONS
❌Removing the post
❌Hidden likes/views
